verdicts.title: Equidistributions of Sign Patterns of the Liouville Function and Normal Numbers
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The equidistribution of the double sign patterns of the Liouville function $λ$ is proved unconditionally. As application, it is shown that the computable real number $$\sum_{n \geq 1} \frac{1+λ(n)}{2^{n}}$$ is a simply normal number in base 4.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns equidistribution of sign patterns of the Liouville function and normality of a derived real number, with no mention of sign matrices, communication complexity, γ_2 norm, or 2-adic cokernel valuations. It shares only the superficial term 'sign' with the conjecture.
